checkpoints.label: Initial Spray
checkpoints.note: A mixture of musk, orange, birch, and ginger. Very clean and elegant for the heat.

checkpoints.label: Dry Down
checkpoints.note: The citruses die down a bit and the birch becomes more prominent. With a bit of sweetness

checkpoints.label: Skin Scent
checkpoints.note: Turns into the lighter aventus style, you still get the light citrus with mostly the birch.

tests.verdict: A stunning signature scent if you love the creed aventus style fragrances.
tests.seasonNotes: Office safe, elegant but also not special occasion. More of a wearable everyday mass appealing scent
tests.cons: another creed inspired fragrance, you get that DNA
tests.name: Gas

checkpoints.label: Initial Spray
checkpoints.note: Vanilla with a very juice fresh pomegranate. 80% pomegranate 30% vanilla

checkpoints.label: Dry Down
checkpoints.note: More of the vanilla comes out and the pomegranate turns into a sweeter version

checkpoints.label: Skin Scent
checkpoints.note: I am barely smelling it on the strip at this point, you primarily get that birch and woodyness that was in the dry down except for it is a bit less

tests.verdict: A stunning fruity sweet vanilla fragrance that has a addicting sexy drydown.
tests.similar: Power of You by Giorgio Armani
tests.seasonNotes: I think it’s a good office scent, very nice for the warmer months especially toward the night time.
tests.pros: The drydown is absolutely addicting to me
tests.cons: The opening with pomegranate  is very punchy
tests.name: Only Ever

checkpoints.label: Initial Spray
checkpoints.note: Very light but picks up quickly. A barbershop scent like Dakkar noir with a bit of green from the petigreen. Almost got a cinnamon smell, probably the cardamom

checkpoints.label: Dry Down
checkpoints.note: Very much a barbershop scent. More similar to Dakkar noir, aftershave.

checkpoints.label: Skin Scent
checkpoints.note: Turns into a very sweet Ambery weaker version of the OG scent

tests.verdict: A beautiful signature scent worthy if barbershop fragrances are your thing.
tests.pros: The barbershop feel that feels clean and nostalgic
tests.cons: The green can be a bit off putting.
tests.name: Gambit
